traditional: 搞到 A V 唔到
jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A V m4 dou2

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial construction for making someone or something unable to do something.

examples.english: That accident could disable him, leaving his leg unable to move.
examples.traditional: 嗰次意外搞到佢隻腳郁唔到。
examples.jyutping: go2 ci3 ji3 ngoi6 gaau2 dou3 keoi5 zek3 goek3 juk1 m4 dou2
